standard.summary: （实验性）ANT（Adaptive Noise Training）：在训练噪声中加入来自数据集的可学习对抗噪声，使模型更鲁棒。
standard.effect: 开启后，训练噪声不再是纯高斯，而是混合了少量从数据集统计量派生的"对抗方向"噪声，提升模型对相关分布的鲁棒性。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能，适合研究对比。ant_blend 控制对抗噪声的混合比例（0.0~1.0）。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。普通 LoRA 训练无需开启。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) ANT (Adaptive Noise Training): mixes learnable adversarial noise derived from the dataset into the training noise to make the model more robust.
standard_en.effect: Once on, the training noise is no longer purely Gaussian -- a small adversarial-direction component derived from dataset statistics is blended in, improving robustness to that distribution.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature suited to research comparisons. ant_blend sets how much adversarial noise is mixed in (0.0-1.0).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. Ordinary LoRA training does not need it.

advanced.principle: ANT 在噪声采样时混合 ε_gaussian 和 ε_adaptive（基于数据集梯度方向的噪声），比例由 ant_blend 控制。对抗噪声让模型被迫对更难的噪声方向进行去噪，提升泛化性。
advanced.tradeoffs: 对抗噪声的计算需要额外的 forward pass 来估计数据方向，增加约 20%~50% 的计算量。效果在大数据集上更显著。

advanced_en.principle: ANT mixes ε_gaussian and ε_adaptive (noise based on dataset gradient direction) at sampling time, with the ratio controlled by ant_blend. Adversarial noise forces the model to denoise harder noise directions, improving generalization.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Adversarial noise needs an extra forward pass to estimate the data direction, adding roughly 20%~50% compute. The effect is more pronounced on large datasets.
